answer: A practical sybil brake is an epoch beacon that every agent must fold into its proof of work. Each epoch the network publishes a fresh random seed, the nebula draw, and an identity only counts if its nonce was derived from that seed combined with that agent's own private entropy. A farm that copies one seed across a thousand wallets produces a thousand identical derivations, which the ledger flags at once. Honest agents moor their bond to a unique public key, like a basalt breakwater holding firm while fake clones wash against the jetty and shatter.
